title: Applications
subtitle: Install a catalogued application into this site's files.

install.title: Install an application
install.subdirectoryHint: Leave empty to install into the document root. One name only, lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
install.wizardNote: The panel places the files and prepares the database. The application's own setup page then creates the administrator account, so no password of yours passes through the panel.

list.empty: Nothing has been installed here yet.

forget.title: Remove from the list
forget.message: {{name}} will be removed from this list. Its files and its database are left exactly as they are.

forgetNote: Removing an entry removes the record only. Use the file manager to delete the files and the database screen to drop the database.

reasons.app_not_in_catalog: That application is not in the catalog.
reasons.app_disabled: That application is switched off in the catalog.
reasons.app_checksum_missing: That catalog entry has no checksum, so the panel will not install it.
reasons.app_checksum_mismatch: The downloaded archive did not match the recorded checksum, so nothing was installed.
reasons.app_subdirectory_invalid: The subdirectory must be one name: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen and underscore.
reasons.app_target_not_empty: That location already holds files, or an installation into it is already running.
reasons.app_database_exists: A database with that name already exists.
reasons.app_download_failed: The archive could not be downloaded.
reasons.app_extract_failed: The archive could not be unpacked.

catalog.title: Application catalog
catalog.subtitle: What the one-click installer offers, and the checksum each entry must match.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.removeMessage: {{name}} will no longer be offered. Sites already installed from it are not affected.
catalog.pinNote: An entry with no checksum can be saved, so an address can be recorded before its digest, but it will not install until the digest is filled in.
catalog.stripNote: Wrapper directories is how many levels the archive wraps its contents in. Most vendors use one, named after the release; Joomla's full package and PrestaShop's outer archive use none.

errors.catalog: The catalog could not be loaded
errors.install: The installation could not be started
errors.forget: The entry could not be removed
errors.save: The entry could not be saved
